title: MeasurementProtocol
description:
The schema root aggregating the request and result surfaces used by the
product-owned Eval and Bench measurement clients. Its optional fields are
code-generation anchors and are never all populated in one message.
$comment: Generated from crates/inferlab-protocol/src/wire.rs and measurement_data_asset.rs; do not edit.

BenchAgenticSourceInput.description: One release-qualified agentic trace source and its complete effective policy.

BenchCaseInput.description: A single Bench case: its load shape and the number of requests to send.

BenchClientRequest.description:
The request the Bench measurement runtime passes to its client: the
endpoint, model, bench definition, the load case to run, and the artifact
directory.

case_budget_seconds.description: Remaining control-plane case budget when the client is released.

BenchClientResult.description: The result a Bench client writes for the measurement runtime to consume.

schema_version.description:
Result envelope version; clients write `1`. The measurement runtime
rejects a bench result whose version is not `1`.

BenchDatasetCacheState.description: Read-only cache state observed while resolving the Bench plan.

BenchDatasetCatalogInput.description: Immutable release-catalog facts resolved by the Rust control plane.

BenchDefinitionInput.description: The workload shape a Bench client drives, shared across its load cases.

BenchInclusiveUniformInput.description: The one bounded distribution currently supported for a token selector.

BenchLoadInput.description: How a Bench case paces its requests.

oneOf.description: A fixed number of in-flight requests.
A target arrival rate, optionally shaped by a burstiness factor.
All requests issued as fast as possible.

BenchNativeInvocation.description: One bounded native post-processing command and its terminal outcome.

BenchPopulationInput.description: One frozen dataset population consumed sequentially by every Bench case.

BenchPopulationPreparationRequest.description:
The bounded tokenizer-backed operation that freezes one request population
before any Bench case starts.

BenchPrefixConditioningInput.description: File-bound exact canonical prefix used to condition a primed cache start.

BenchPrefixGeometrySummary.description: Resolved exact final-prompt prefix geometry across one frozen population.

BenchPrefixSharingInput.description: One declared exact final-prompt prefix geometry.

BenchPromptCacheObservation.description: Backend-reported prompt/cache token accounting for one completed profiling request.

BenchPromptInput.description:
The frozen prompt representation, route, and rendering authority for a
serving Bench population.

BenchPromptRouteInput.description: The named OpenAI-compatible endpoint family derived from prompt authority.

BenchPromptTemplateProjection.description: The concrete template used only for local complete-prompt projection.

BenchPromptTemplateSource.description:
Where the concrete template used for local prompt-length projection came
from. The model server remains authoritative for transport rendering.

BenchPromptTokenReconciliation.description: One synthetic profiling request's planned-to-observed prompt-token check.

BenchPromptTokenTargetingSummary.description: Summary of best-effort complete-prompt targeting for a synthetic population.

BenchRandomShapeInput.description: One exact ISL/OSL pair and its relative categorical sampling weight.

BenchRenderingAuthorityInput.description: The owner that turns semantic prompt input into the final prompt tokens.

BenchRequestRepresentationInput.description: The request payload representation frozen by prompt resolution.

BenchRequestSloInput.description: Per-request latency bounds lowered to the release-owned Bench runner.

BenchRequestSloResult.description: File-bound request-SLO evidence derived from AIPerf profiling records.

BenchRequestSourceInput.description: One closed request origin lowered by Inferlab for the Bench runtime.

oneOf.description:
AIPerf generates exact token-shape prompts from the release-pinned
synthetic generator.

AIPerf samples exact token-shape pairs from one seeded categorical
distribution.

Inferlab materializes a release-catalog conversation snapshot before
AIPerf starts.

BenchRuntimeSessionResult.description: Terminal evidence for one admitted runtime session.

BenchSessionDatasetCatalogInput.description:
Immutable release-catalog facts for a linear-session materializer. AIPerf
loader names are deliberately absent from this source boundary.

BenchSessionPhaseSummary.description: Reconciled native evidence for one session-bounded Bench phase.

BenchSessionResultEvidence.description: Session and transport reconciliation returned by the Bench client.

BenchSessionSourceInput.description: One release-qualified population of dependent linear session templates.

BenchSessionTemplateInput.description:
One frozen linear-template summary needed to assign case slices without
duplicating the content-bearing population evidence artifact.

BenchSessionTurnResult.description: One native transport request reconciled to a linear-session turn.

BenchSharedSystemContentInput.description:
One pre-template shared system-content declaration for server-rendered
synthetic chat.

BenchSharedSystemContentSummary.description:
Resolved pre-template shared system-content shape across one frozen
server-chat population.

BenchTokenCountSummary.description:
Summary of the realized token counts. Exact per-entry values remain in the
population evidence artifact.

BenchTokenSelectorInput.description: One fixed or bounded inclusive-uniform token-length selector.

ClientEndpointInput.description: The public workload endpoint an Eval or Bench client connects to.

ClientStatus.description: The terminal outcome a measurement client reports.

oneOf.description: The client completed its measurement successfully.
The client did not complete successfully.

EndpointProtocol.description: The application protocol a workload endpoint speaks.

EvalClientRequest.description:
The request the Eval measurement runtime passes to its client: the endpoint
to hit, the model, the eval definition, and where to write artifacts.

case_budget_seconds.description: Remaining control-plane case budget when the client is released.

EvalClientResult.description: The result an Eval client writes for the measurement runtime to consume.

schema_version.description:
Result envelope version; clients write `1`. The measurement runtime
rejects an eval result whose version is not `1`.

EvalDefinitionInput.description: The measurement an Eval client runs against the workload endpoint.

oneOf.description: An lm-eval task run with a pass threshold on the chosen metric.

declared_prompt.description: The authority the definition declared, absent when it was defaulted.

prompt.description: The prompt rendering authority resolution selected.

EvalFailureKind.description: A typed Eval failure category preserved across the client boundary.

EvalMetricComparison.description: The threshold comparison selected from lm-eval's scoring direction.

EvalMetricGate.description: The effective threshold comparison for the configured primary metric.

EvalMetricGateConclusion.description: The terminal conclusion of an lm-eval metric threshold gate.

EvalNormalizedMetric.description: One finite lm-eval metric with its exact native provenance.

prompt_authority.description:
The prompt rendering authority that produced this value. The same task
scored under another authority is a different measurement, so the value
never travels without it.

EvalPreparedSourceBinding.description: The immutable workspace-task snapshot consumed by one Eval client.

EvalPromptInput.description:
The prompt rendering authority for a generative lm-eval definition.

The authority determines the protocol route and the release-pinned lm-eval
client; the runner rejects an authority the resolved task output type does
not permit.

oneOf.description: Ordinary text on the completions path with no chat construction.
Structured messages on the chat-completions path, rendered by the server.

EvalTaskSourceInput.description: The resolved lm-eval task source consumed by the release-owned Eval runner.

oneOf.description: One individual task shipped by the pinned lm-eval runtime.
One task closure shipped and identity-bound by the Inferlab release.
One validated workspace-local lm-eval YAML file.

EvalTrialSummary.description: Reconstructible aggregate counts for fixed outer Eval trials.

MeasurementDataAssetAcquiredSource.description: The complete immutable source identity established by preparation.

MeasurementDataAssetCacheOutcome.description: Read-only or preparation-time outcome for one independently owned cache.

MeasurementDataAssetCacheStore.description: One effective physical cache store as reported by its owning runtime.

MeasurementDataAssetContentEntry.description: One member of a complete, ordered content closure.

MeasurementDataAssetEffectiveSelection.description: The effective selection reported by the owning measurement runtime.

MeasurementDataAssetPreparationNextPhase.description:
The next separately durable preparation phase selected by the owning
runtime after source resolution.

MeasurementDataAssetPreparationPhase.description:
One externally observable source-preparation phase. Separating resolution
from acquisition lets the control plane durably commit each result.

MeasurementDataAssetPreparationRequest.description:
One narrowly scoped source-preparation request issued before measurement
materialization. The selected measurement definition remains authoritative
for dataset semantics.

MeasurementDataAssetPreparationResult.description: Terminal result returned by the owning measurement runtime.

MeasurementDataAssetReadiness.description:
Whether preparation established a closed source or an explicitly opaque
non-reproducible source.

MeasurementDataAssetRemoteMetadataOutcom.description: Whether preparation contacted a remote metadata authority.

MeasurementDataAssetSourceBytesOutcome.description: Whether immutable source bytes were reused or downloaded.

MeasurementDataAssetSourceInput.description: The measurement-owned source whose bytes or task selection are prepared.

MeasurementDataAssetVerification.description: Expected-versus-observed integrity evidence for qualified source content.

MeasurementDataFiles.description: A normalized mapping from dataset split names to selected file patterns.

MeasurementModelInput.description:
The model identity used by measurement clients. Unlike integration
planning, a benchmark client may need a controller-visible tokenizer
locator.

PromptCacheReadZeroRepresentation.description: How a backend with cache reporting enabled represents a zero-token cache read.

ProtocolVersion.description:
The shared protocol version used by framework integrations and release-owned
measurement clients. The only accepted value is `7` (serialized as the
string `"7"`); a mismatch is rejected before lowering.

RawArtifact.description: A raw output file a client produced, retained as workload evidence.

ServerMetricsEndpointInput.description: The resolved server-metrics endpoint supplied to a measurement client.

SettingValue.description:
A framework-specific server setting value carried as structured JSON data
(never a pre-rendered shell fragment) across the integration boundary.

anyOf.description: A JSON array of setting values.
A JSON object of named setting values.
